morgan_sec: Heads-up — pen test retest is proposed for Wed 2026-04-14 09:00-12:00 PT. Need to lock down RBAC snapshot, ensure KMS proxy allows read-only decrypt for assessors, and create an immutable audit log export. Can we confirm owners and blockers?

alex_infra: I have a minor infra rollout planned that morning (network routing patch). I'm happy to postpone but need to know cutoff.

morgan_sec: @alex_infra if we can freeze any infra changes from 06:00-14:00 PT that day that'd be ideal. The assessors need a stable environment and predictable logs.

jamie_ops: We can freeze. Two questions: 1) exact audit streams to snapshot (app/access/runtime), 2) KMS flow — do assessors need decrypt OR just ciphertext proof?

lea_sre: They requested ability to validate logs and replay traces for a 3-hour window. So we should export: app-logs, auth-logs, runtime-traces. Export window: 08:45-12:30 PT (covering a buffer). We must also capture KV cache metrics for inference nodes.

ben_research: For KMS, assessors usually need decrypt to validate signatures on ephemeral artifacts. We should provide a read-only proxy that allows Decrypt but does not expose key material or key usage logs to them directly — KMS proxy should mediate and audit every call.

morgan_sec: Proposed KMS plan: create an assessor IAM role with sts:AssumeRole for the retest window, grant a proxy service (kms-proxy) permission to call kms:Decrypt only, and log every proxy request to the audit bucket. Ephemeral creds TTL = 3h. Thoughts?

alex_infra: Fine, can do proxy. Implementation notes: we will create a role kms-proxy@infrasvc and a role assessor-retest@assessors. Proxy will run in VPC with NAT to KMS endpoint. Need to coordinate KMS key policy to allow proxy role decrypt. Also need to avoid rotating the key 7 days before/after, so schedule lock.

jamie_ops: Audit export details: We'll write S3 export with server-side encryption using the same KMS key. Mark objects with Object Lock (Governance) for 90 days retention. We'll also generate a manifest with SHA256 checksums and include an export of CloudTrail events filtered for KMS and AssumeRole events.

lea_sre: Runtime capture: enable trace-level APM sampling for the window and increase log retention for staging cluster to 180 days (temporary). Please also snapshot prom metrics (push to long-term TSDB snapshot).

morgan_sec: Can you share exact CLI snippets for the assessor role assumption and proxy usage so I can include them in the intake packet?

ben_research: Sure. Example assume-flow:```bash
# assessor gets temporary creds
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/assessor-retest --role-session-name pen-test --duration-seconds 10800
# use creds to call proxy (proxy endpoint enforces decryption policy)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <temp-token>" https://kms-proxy.redwood-internal/api/v1/decrypt -d '{"ciphertext":"..."}'
```Make sure the proxy validates caller and writes an audit record with request_id and key_id.

alex_infra: For key policy: we'll add a statement allowing arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/kms-proxy to use kms:Decrypt and kms:DescribeKey. No direct access to assessor role. Also set kms:ViaService conditions if needed.

jamie_ops: I will create an export playbook. Quick checklist I'm adding to the ticket: 
- freeze infra rollouts 06:00-14:00 PT
- create assessor-retest role with MFA disabled for automation? (we should discuss)
- create kms-proxy service in VPC and attach policy
- S3 export with Object Lock Governance 90d + manifest + checksums
- CloudTrail filter: KMS, STS, S3 PutObject, IAM policy changes
- APM trace-level window + Prom snapshot

lea_sre: Please do NOT disable MFA on assessor role. Instead allow AWS SSO short-lived sessions or a dedicated automation principal. We must preserve principle-of-least-privilege. If assessors need automation, generate temporary access via a human-approved runbook.

morgan_sec: Agreed — no permanent MFA disable. We'll rely on short-lived sts creds issued by our CI approval pipeline. Include an approval step in the ticket for creation of assessor role.

jamie_ops: ack. I'll include an approval gate in the playbook and annotate owner contacts. Who will hand over evidence to assessors once export completes?

alex_infra: Ops will seed S3 with the manifest and create a presigned, time-limited read-only manifest URL for assessors. We will not hand key material. The proxy will be the only service that can call Decrypt.

ben_research: One more: telemetry integrity. We should snapshot CloudWatch logs + S3 exported logs and also create a signed bundle with our internal GPG key so assessors can't later claim tampering.

morgan_sec: Good call. Add GPG sig step to the playbook.

auditbot: Ticket PT-5729 created: "retest 2026-04-14 — KMS proxy, RBAC snapshot, audit export" assigned to #eng-infra, #eng-ops, #eng-sre. Approval gate: Security manager signoff required.

jamie_ops: I'll schedule a short dry-run on Mon 4/12 09:00 PT to exercise the proxy flow and export. Please RSVP if you want to attend.

lea_sre: I'll join. Also can someone confirm we have enough retention quota on the long-term TSDB?

alex_infra: I'll check and post numbers in the ticket. If quota is low, we can push only the selected namespaces and sample traces.

morgan_sec: Thanks all. Action items for record: 
- @alex_infra: implement kms-proxy role and key policy, set key rotation freeze window
- @jamie_ops: build export playbook, Object Lock S3 bucket, CloudTrail filter, create dry-run checklist
- @lea_sre: enable APM trace sampling + TSDB snapshot plan
- @ben_research: prepare GPG signing process and manifest format
- @morgan_sec: coordinate assessor intake and approval gate

morgan_sec: I'll update PT intake doc with these steps and attach playbook once Jamie posts it.

alex_infra: noted, will try to have infra PR ready by EOD Fri.

jamie_ops: Thanks — adding follow-ups to PT-5729 and pinging stakeholders. :thumbsup:

morgan_sec: Closing thread — will reopen if blockers surface before dry-run.

auditbot: PT-5729 status: open -> in_progress (assigned).
